requirements: Verify external Models identity, current mount, destination ancestors and available bytes before any write.
No symlink escape, internal or X9 fallback; fail closed.
Use one verified source copy, an isolated environment and explicit offline paths; no modifications to existing environments.
All model payloads, environments, caches, temporary files and logs remain on the external Models partition.
Generated size reservations are estimates, not measured artifacts. Stop before any allocation exceeds its budget.
Recheck free space after acquisition and before each conversion.
Do not move or delete existing files.
Memory use is unmeasured; load one model at a time, measure resident and MLX memory, and stop at the recorded conservative thresholds.
guard_implementation_status: plan only; no acquisition or storage-writing command included
memory_threshold_scope: Conservative engineering stop thresholds, measured independently without double-counting. Not observed peak usage; never raise automatically.
